fingerprint_policy.if_binary_readable: AI/tool MUST automatically compute SHA-256 from actual image bytes and use it as the fingerprint basis.
fingerprint_policy.if_github_asset: Record Git blob SHA and compute SHA-256 when bytes are accessible; a stable Git blob SHA may be retained as additional identity evidence.
fingerprint_policy.if_user_file_without_raw_hash_access: Use a platform-provided immutable attachment/file identifier only when it is stable for that exact uploaded binary/version.
fingerprint_policy.if_no_reliable_fingerprint_available: Set page status and manifest_identity_status to BLOCKED_ASSET_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE. Do not activate this manifest and do not start or continue R10/R11/R12 review on this asset version.

activation_gate.rule: Every page with status=ACTIVE must have a non-empty verifiable fingerprint and asset_ref. If any required ACTIVE page lacks verifiable identity, the whole manifest is not activatable and production enters BLOCKED_ASSET_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE.

revision_rules: Any actual image byte/content change requires manifest_revision+1.
For a changed page keep the stable asset_id, increment only that page's asset_revision, and generate a new non-empty fingerprint.
Unchanged pages preserve asset_id, asset_revision and fingerprint exactly.
Previous manifest files are immutable and must remain readable; never overwrite an old manifest revision.
R01 activates only one exact manifest path/id/revision after activation_gate PASS.
review_invalidation_rule: If a page asset_revision or fingerprint differs from the version cited by a review, that page-dependent review evidence is automatically STALE and cannot count toward a PASS barrier.
review_identity_rule: R10/R11/R12 evidence is invalid if any in-scope ACTIVE asset has an empty/unverifiable fingerprint or the manifest_identity_status is BLOCKED_ASSET_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE.
example_p3_only_revision: If P3 changes: manifest_revision+1; P3 asset_revision+1 and new non-empty fingerprint; P1/P2/P4/P5/P6 keep their previous asset revisions and fingerprints.
